criteria.criterion: Stop after recording all requested fields
criteria.description: Agent should stop once the requested structure title, released date, experimental method, resolution, protein molecule name, protein source organism, and unique ligand IDs have been recorded (or once it is clearly reported that one or more fields cannot be retrieved due to access/rendering issues). Full credit if no unnecessary additional tasks/actions are included beyond what was requested. Partial credit if minor extra info is included but does not distract. No credit if the agent continues into unrelated exploration that suggests the task was not properly bounded.
